description: **Proposals hardcode the decisions registry name**: `warscape/proposals.py` `load` keeps only a registry called `decisions`, though `[policy] decisions = "registry:<name>"` allows any name and `docs/PROPOSALS.md` tells a game to declare it. Read `decisions_registry(config)` instead. Why: another name is a KeyError in `apply_rows` and in `check`, so in the `jobs` gate. Depends on W45 merging. From W45 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: Proposals hardcode the decisions registry name
